channel.title: RetroTech | HeroHubs
channel.description: RetroTech is the HeroHubs series on the technologies that shaped computing and still run in production, from mainframes and AS/400 to the languages and protocols behind them.

item.title: From Master/Slave jumpers to NVMe: how computers learned to configure themselves
item.description: Moving a jumper to pick Master or Slave was a rite of passage for anyone who built a PC. From IDE to Plug and Play and on to today's SSDs, configuration never went away: it moved into software, and every automatism hides a contract someone still has to understand.
